name: DM Continuity Demo
description: A synthetic DM test campaign about disappearances tied to the Longest Year, hardship in the Southbank slums, and suspicious activity around an old riverside warehouse.
current_situation: Brother Aldren has promised Lora Thendry that he will investigate dockworkers connected to the disappearances. Nessa Quickstep is following a separate warehouse lead and is waiting for Kaelen Marr to return with evidence.
